title: Notice regarding Special Courts on 30.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 29/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 30/10/2026;
matters as per the Notification dated 27.10.2026.

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 29/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 30/10/2026;
1. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice Mr. Justice Manash
Ranjan Pathak and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble the Acting
Chief Justice Mr. Justice Manash Ranjan Pathak would sit Single
and take up the matters as per Roster.
3. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D. Karia and Hon’ble
Ms. Justice Nisha M. Thakore would sit in Special Division Bench
and take up the notified matter/s.
4. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 3 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Bhargav D. Karia and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi would sit
in Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
5. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 4 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Bhargav D. Karia and Hon’ble Mr. Justice L. S. Pirzada would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
6. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 5 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Bhargav D. Karia and Hon’ble Mr. Justice D. N. Ray would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matters.
7. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 6 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Bhargav D. Karia would sit Single and take up the notified
matter/s.
8. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen would sit
Single and take up the notified matters.
9. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora would sit Single and
take up the notified matters.
10. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 9 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice R.T.Vachhani would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matters.
11. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 4 and Sr. No. 10 above,
Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav
Trivedi would sit in Regular Division Bench and take up the
matters as per Roster.
12. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S. Desai would sit Single
and take up the notified matters.
13. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 1 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Nikhil S. Kariel would sit Single and take up the notified matters.
14. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Hemant M. Prachchhak and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice Mool Chand Tyagi would sit in Special Division
Bench and take up the notified matters.
15. At 03:00 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Hemant M. Prachchhak would sit
Single and take up the notified matter/s.
16. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 3 above, Hon’ble Ms. Justice
Nisha M. Thakore would sit Single and take up the notified
matter/s.
17. At 04:45 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi would sit Single and
take up the matters as per Roster.
18. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 5 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Sanjeev J. Thaker and Hon’ble Mr. Justice L. S. Pirzada would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
19. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 6 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
D. N. Ray would take up the Specially assigned Arbitration
matters as per the Notification dated 27.10.2026.
20. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 18 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
L. S. Pirzada would sit Single and take up the matters as per
Roster.
21. After the work of Division Bench is over, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
J. L. Odedra would sit Single and take up the notified matters.
22. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 14 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Mool Chand Tyagi would sit Single and take up the matters as per
Roster.
23. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai would
sit Single and take up the notified matters.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar Judicial
